rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE-approved programs (general hours) or Board-approved courses listed in CE Broker; medication errors, controlled substances and HIV/AIDS courses must be Board approved; ACPE-P numbers only (technician ACPE-T courses do not count)
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal under 12 months after licensure: only 1 h HIV/AIDS, 2 h medication errors and 2 h controlled substances. First renewal 12 months or more after licensure: 15 hours including those subjects.

topics.who: All pharmacists; Board-approved course on root-cause analysis, error reduction and patient safety
Board-approved course incl. Florida HIV/AIDS law
Immunization-certified pharmacists: vaccine course, within the 30 hours

rules.notes: 26 general + 2 controlled substances + 2 medication errors. Immunization-certified pharmacists: 3-hour vaccine course (within the 30). Collaborative practice: +8 h; test and treat: 3 h. Current licenses expire Sept 30, 2027.
rules.alternatives: Up to 10 h per biennium for attending Board disciplinary meetings (5 h per day); up to 5 h for approved volunteer service to the indigent; 5 h per semester hour of post-professional degree courses.
rules.legal_basis: Fla. Admin. Code R. 64B16-26.103; Fla. Stat. §465.009
